mode_requirement: At least one of --archive-source-files-json or --archive-pack-json must be provided.

determinism.stable_verification_hash_expectation: Repeated runs over identical normalized inputs must preserve the same restore verification hash.
determinism.compaction_preservation_rule: Replay-critical artifacts remain required after compaction, but duplicate replay paths collapse to the retained path from the compaction plan.
determinism.execution_mode: Exporter and verifier only; no live remote fetches and no cargo execution.
